Checking your local connection…

Your key lives in .env in the DraftMango folder, beside serve.mjs. Set OPENAI_API_KEY and save the file.

Choose a model with OPENAI_MODEL. Saving the file takes effect on your next request.

Generating sends your prompt, recent conversation and current website files to OpenAI. API usage is billed to your OpenAI account. Projects use your connected Draftmango account.

Workspace guide

Build, edit, and manage your website from one workspace.

Edit your code

Edit HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Drafts save as you type; Run preview applies all three files and creates a version in History. Ctrl/Cmd + S also runs the preview. The preview is isolated from your account and browser storage.

Build with AI

Describe a website or a change in your own words. Your AI provider uses your current files and recent conversation to update the preview. Each applied edit stays in History. Your prompts and project files are sent to your configured AI provider when you submit a request.

Design settings

Change the name, words, palette, and layout in Design. Use desktop, tablet, and mobile previews to see how it all fits.

Version history

Undo, redo, or restore a previous draft. Projects sync to your account when the local account service is available.

Export your website

Export a standalone HTML file with its images included. Publishing to a live domain isn’t connected yet.
